source: lms load --help and the app's model load panel (hand-seeded)
notes: LM Studio settings are usually clicked, not typed, so args here describe the load configuration however it was set. Record the backend runtime version (llama.cpp build or MLX version) in engine.build_flags: the app version alone does not determine the numbers.

params.name: path
params.help: Model key in the local LM Studio library. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: context-length
params.help: Context window. Defaults to the model's own, capped by the app.

params.name: gpu
params.help: GPU offload ratio: off, max, auto or a number between 0 and 1.

params.name: cpu-threads
params.help: CPU threads for the llama.cpp runtime.

params.name: flash-attention
params.help: Flash attention in the llama.cpp runtime.

params.name: kv-cache-quantization
params.help: KV cache type in the llama.cpp runtime.

params.name: keep-model-in-memory
params.help: Prevent the model being paged out.

params.name: ttl
params.help: Seconds of idleness before the model is unloaded. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: identifier
params.help: Name the API reports. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.
